sources.title: Niveau A2 pour le français : un référentiel (Beacco, Lepage, Porquier, Riba, Didier 2008), chapitre 5 « Grammaire : morphologie et structures des énoncés et des phrases »
Inventaire linguistique des contenus clés des niveaux du CECRL (Eaquals et CIEP / France Éducation international, 2015), annexes D, E et F (grammaire A1-C1 et réalisations langagières)
Grammaire progressive du français, niveau avancé (Boularès et Frérot, CLE International), table des matières d'après la notice de catalogue
Éléments de grammaire B1-B2 (Maison des langues, Université de Genève, cours d'été de français, 2025)
Éléments de grammaire C1 (Maison des langues, Université de Genève, cours d'été de français, 2025)
Français langue étrangère, Grammaire B1 : programme (Université Paris Cité, département LANSAD)
Kwiziq French: grammar lessons by CEFR level (A2, B1, B2 and C1 lists)
Les temps littéraires (EdTech Books, module de cours de français)
Lingolia Français : grammaire française, leçons et exercices classés de A1 à C1 (plan du site)
Difficultés de la langue française vues par les croatophones (Darja Damić Bohač, FF Open Press, Université de Zagreb, 2022), chapitre 11 « Verbes et constructions impersonnels »
L'apposition dans la production écrite des apprenants lituaniens en FLE (Vitalija Kazlauskienė, Sustainable Multilingualism 15, 2019), corpus d'apprenants de niveau B1
Vitrine linguistique de l'Office québécois de la langue française, « Valeurs particulières du subjonctif »

constructs.name: présent de l'indicatif (verbes en -er)
aliases: présent des verbes du premier groupe
constructs.description: Present tense of regular -er verbs: one stem plus the endings -e, -es, -e, -ons, -ez, -ent.

constructs.name: présent de l'indicatif (verbes en -ir à deux radicaux)
aliases: présent des verbes du deuxième groupe
constructs.description: Present tense of second-group -ir verbs, which insert -iss- in the plural.

constructs.name: présent de l'indicatif (verbes irréguliers)
aliases: présent des verbes du troisième groupe
constructs.description: Present tense of irregular and third-group verbs, with changing stems in the singular and plural.

constructs.name: présent de l'indicatif (emplois)
constructs.description: Uses of the present: current facts, habits, general truths and near future.

constructs.name: présent progressif (être en train de + infinitif)
constructs.description: Expresses an action in progress at a given moment.

constructs.name: futur proche (aller + infinitif)
constructs.description: Expresses a future action seen as near or already planned.

constructs.name: passé récent (venir de + infinitif)
constructs.description: Expresses an action that has just happened.

constructs.name: passé composé avec avoir
constructs.description: Compound past formed with avoir in the present plus the past participle.

constructs.name: passé composé avec être
constructs.description: Compound past formed with être for a set of intransitive verbs of movement and change of state, with the participle agreeing with the subject.

constructs.name: passé composé (emplois)
constructs.description: Uses of the passé composé for completed past events, successions of actions and results.

constructs.name: verbes à double auxiliaire (avoir ou être)
constructs.description: Verbs like monter or sortir that take être when intransitive and avoir when they have a direct object.

constructs.name: imparfait (formation)
constructs.description: Imperfect tense built on the nous stem of the present plus -ais, -ais, -ait, -ions, -iez, -aient.

constructs.name: imparfait (description et habitude)
constructs.description: Use of the imperfect for background, descriptions, states and repeated actions in the past.

constructs.name: alternance passé composé et imparfait
aliases: temps du passé dans le récit
constructs.description: Choosing between passé composé for events and imparfait for background when telling a story.

constructs.name: futur simple (formation)
constructs.description: Simple future formed on the infinitive (or an irregular stem) plus -ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont.

constructs.name: futur simple (emplois)
constructs.description: Use of the simple future for predictions, promises, plans and instructions.

constructs.name: plus-que-parfait
constructs.description: Compound tense (imparfait of avoir or être plus past participle) for an action before another past action.

constructs.name: futur dans le passé
aliases: conditionnel à valeur de futur dans le passé
constructs.description: Conditional used to express a later event seen from a past point of view.

constructs.name: futur proche dans le passé (aller à l'imparfait + infinitif)
constructs.description: Aller in the imperfect plus infinitive for an action that was about to happen in the past.

constructs.name: futur antérieur
constructs.description: Compound future (future of avoir or être plus past participle) for an action completed before a future point.

constructs.name: passé simple
constructs.description: Simple past of written narrative, history and biography, replacing the passé composé in literary texts.

constructs.name: passé antérieur
constructs.description: Literary compound tense (passé simple of avoir or être plus past participle) for an action just before another in the passé simple.

constructs.name: impératif (formation)
constructs.description: Imperative forms (tu, nous, vous) without a subject pronoun, to give orders, advice or instructions.

constructs.name: impératif négatif
constructs.description: Negative imperative, with ne before and pas after the verb, to forbid or warn.

constructs.name: conditionnel de politesse
constructs.description: Conditional of a few verbs used as fixed polite forms to ask for something.

constructs.name: conditionnel présent (formation)
constructs.description: Present conditional formed on the future stem plus the imperfect endings.

constructs.name: conditionnel présent (souhait, conseil, suggestion)
constructs.description: Present conditional to express wishes, advice, suggestions and imagined situations.

constructs.name: conditionnel (information non confirmée)
constructs.description: Conditional used to report information that is not confirmed, typical of the press.

constructs.name: conditionnel passé (formation)
constructs.description: Past conditional formed with avoir or être in the conditional plus the past participle.

constructs.name: conditionnel passé (regret, reproche)
aliases: past conditional for regret and reproach
constructs.description: Past conditional to express regret, reproach or an unrealised possibility in the past.

constructs.name: subjonctif présent (formation)
constructs.description: Present subjunctive built on the ils stem of the present plus -e, -es, -e, -ions, -iez, -ent, with irregular verbs.

constructs.name: subjonctif après expressions d'obligation
constructs.description: Subjunctive after expressions of obligation and necessity.

constructs.name: subjonctif après expressions de volonté
constructs.description: Subjunctive after verbs and expressions of will, wish, order or permission.

constructs.name: subjonctif après expressions de sentiment
constructs.description: Subjunctive after verbs, adjectives and nouns expressing feelings such as joy, fear or regret.

constructs.name: subjonctif ou indicatif après verbes d'opinion
constructs.description: Choice of mood after verbs of opinion, hope and certainty, which take the indicative when affirmative.

constructs.name: subjonctif ou infinitif
constructs.description: Use of the infinitive instead of the subjunctive when both clauses have the same subject.

constructs.name: subjonctif après conjonctions de but
constructs.description: Subjunctive after conjunctions expressing purpose.

constructs.name: subjonctif après conjonctions de concession
constructs.description: Subjunctive after conjunctions expressing concession.

constructs.name: subjonctif après expressions de doute et de possibilité
constructs.description: Subjunctive after verbs and impersonal expressions of doubt, possibility and uncertainty.

constructs.name: subjonctif après verbes d'opinion à la forme négative ou interrogative
aliases: je ne pense pas que + subjonctif
constructs.description: Subjunctive after verbs of opinion when they are negative or inverted in a question.

constructs.name: subjonctif après expressions impersonnelles de jugement
constructs.description: Subjunctive after impersonal expressions of judgement or appreciation.

constructs.name: subjonctif après conjonctions de temps
constructs.description: Subjunctive after conjunctions of time that point to a later or expected event.

constructs.name: subjonctif après conjonctions de condition
constructs.description: Subjunctive after conjunctions that state a condition or a restriction.

constructs.name: subjonctif après sans que
constructs.description: Subjunctive after sans que ('without') for something that does not happen alongside the main action; with the same subject, sans + infinitive is used instead.

constructs.name: subjonctif passé
constructs.description: Past subjunctive (subjunctive of avoir or être plus past participle) for an action completed before the main one.

constructs.name: subjonctif dans les relatives
constructs.description: Subjunctive in relative clauses after a superlative or 'the only', or describing something sought or uncertain.

constructs.name: subjonctif dans une proposition indépendante (ordre, souhait)
constructs.description: A que + subjunctive sentence standing on its own, giving an order to a third person or expressing a wish (also with pourvu que); it does not depend on a following main clause.

constructs.name: subjonctif après conjonctions de crainte
constructs.description: Subjunctive after conjunctions expressing fear or a purpose to avoid.

constructs.name: subjonctif après verbe + à ce que
constructs.description: Subjunctive after verbs built with à, which introduce the clause with à ce que.

constructs.name: subjonctif après relatifs indéfinis de concession
constructs.description: Subjunctive after indefinite concessive expressions meaning whoever, whatever or wherever.

constructs.name: subjonctif après cause rejetée
constructs.description: Subjunctive after expressions that reject a possible cause.

constructs.name: que + subjonctif en tête de phrase
constructs.description: A que-clause in the subjunctive placed first, as subject or to express an alternative.

constructs.name: imparfait du subjonctif
constructs.description: Literary subjunctive tense built on the passé simple, found in older and literary narrative.

constructs.name: plus-que-parfait du subjonctif
constructs.description: Literary compound subjunctive, also used in literature as a past conditional.

constructs.name: participe passé (formation)
constructs.description: Regular and irregular forms of the past participle, used in compound tenses and the passive.

constructs.name: verbe + infinitif (sans préposition)
constructs.description: Verbs such as the modals or verbs of liking followed directly by an infinitive.

constructs.name: il faut + infinitif
constructs.description: Impersonal expression of obligation or prohibition followed by an infinitive.

constructs.name: verbe + à + infinitif
constructs.description: Verbs whose infinitive complement is introduced by à.

constructs.name: verbe + de + infinitif
constructs.description: Verbs whose infinitive complement is introduced by de.

constructs.name: adjectif + préposition + infinitif
constructs.description: Adjectives followed by de or à and an infinitive.

constructs.name: préposition + infinitif
constructs.description: Prepositions other than those of purpose followed by an infinitive.

constructs.name: infinitif à valeur d'impératif
constructs.description: Infinitive used instead of the imperative in instructions, notices and recipes.

constructs.name: participe passé employé comme adjectif
aliases: past participle used as an adjective
constructs.description: Past participle used without an auxiliary to describe a noun, agreeing with it like an adjective.

constructs.name: gérondif
constructs.description: En plus the present participle, expressing simultaneity, manner, means, cause or condition with the same subject.

constructs.name: infinitif passé
constructs.description: Avoir or être in the infinitive plus past participle, for an action completed before the main one.

constructs.name: proposition infinitive (verbe de perception + infinitif)
aliases: infinitive clause after verbs of perception
constructs.description: A verb of perception followed by an infinitive that has its own subject, the person or thing perceived.

constructs.name: participe présent
constructs.description: Invariable -ant form used mainly in writing, replacing a relative clause or expressing cause.

constructs.name: adjectif verbal
constructs.description: Adjective derived from a present participle, which agrees with its noun and may differ in spelling.

constructs.name: participe présent (forme composée)
constructs.description: Compound participle (ayant or étant plus past participle) for a completed action, often expressing cause.

constructs.name: verbes pronominaux (présent)
constructs.description: Verbs conjugated with a reflexive pronoun of the same person as the subject.

constructs.name: verbes impersonnels
constructs.description: Verbs used only with the impersonal subject il, such as weather verbs and the verb of necessity.

constructs.name: verbes pronominaux aux temps composés
constructs.description: Pronominal verbs in compound tenses, always with the auxiliary être.

constructs.name: voix passive (formation)
constructs.description: Être in the required tense plus the past participle, which agrees with the subject.

constructs.name: complément d'agent
constructs.description: Introducing the agent of a passive verb with par or, for verbs of feeling and states, with de.

constructs.name: verbes pronominaux réciproques
constructs.description: Plural pronominal verbs expressing a mutual action.

constructs.name: verbes pronominaux à sens passif
constructs.description: Pronominal construction with a non-human subject, used with a passive meaning.

constructs.name: construction impersonnelle
constructs.description: Ordinary verbs used with impersonal il, placing the real subject after the verb.

constructs.name: faire causatif (faire + infinitif)
constructs.description: Faire plus infinitive, meaning to make someone do something or have something done.

constructs.name: se faire + infinitif
aliases: to get something done to oneself
constructs.description: Se faire plus infinitive, presenting the subject as undergoing an action or having it done.

constructs.name: laisser + infinitif
constructs.description: Laisser plus infinitive, meaning to let or allow something to happen.

constructs.name: pronoms personnels sujets
constructs.description: Subject pronouns, including the choice between tu and vous.

constructs.name: pronoms toniques
constructs.description: Stressed pronoun forms used alone, after prepositions, after c'est and for emphasis.

constructs.name: pronoms démonstratifs neutres
constructs.description: Invariable demonstratives referring to things, ideas or situations.

constructs.name: pronom on
constructs.description: On used for 'we', for people in general or for an unspecified someone.

constructs.name: pronoms compléments d'objet direct
constructs.description: Pronouns replacing a direct object, placed before the conjugated verb.

constructs.name: pronoms compléments d'objet indirect
constructs.description: Pronouns replacing a person introduced by à, placed before the verb.

constructs.name: pronom en (quantité)
constructs.description: En replacing a noun with a partitive, indefinite article or expression of quantity.

constructs.name: pronom y (lieu)
constructs.description: Y replacing a place introduced by à, en, dans or chez.

constructs.name: pronoms démonstratifs variables
constructs.description: Demonstrative pronouns agreeing with the noun they replace, often with -ci or -là.

constructs.name: pronoms possessifs
constructs.description: Pronouns replacing a possessive determiner plus noun.

constructs.name: pronoms indéfinis de personne et de chose
constructs.description: Indefinite pronouns for an unspecified person or thing, and tout.

constructs.name: pronom relatif qui
constructs.description: Qui introducing a relative clause in which it is the subject.

constructs.name: pronom relatif que
constructs.description: Que introducing a relative clause in which it is the direct object.

constructs.name: pronom relatif où
aliases: où relatif de lieu et de temps
constructs.description: Où introducing a relative clause of place or time.

constructs.name: pronom relatif dont
constructs.description: Dont replacing a complement introduced by de, including possession.

constructs.name: pronoms relatifs composés
constructs.description: Relative pronouns after a preposition, with lequel and its contracted forms or qui for people.

constructs.name: pronoms relatifs neutres (ce qui, ce que, ce dont)
aliases: tout ce qui, tout ce que
constructs.description: Relative pronouns with the antecedent ce, meaning 'what' or 'the thing that'.

constructs.name: pronoms en et y (compléments de verbes prépositionnels)
constructs.description: En and y replacing a complement of a verb built with de or à.

constructs.name: double pronominalisation
constructs.description: Two object pronouns together before the verb, in a fixed order.

constructs.name: pronoms indéfinis de quantité
constructs.description: Indefinite pronouns expressing an imprecise quantity or each member of a group.

constructs.name: pronoms démonstratifs suivis d'une relative ou de de
constructs.description: Demonstrative pronouns followed by a relative clause or a de-complement instead of -ci/-là.

constructs.name: pronom neutre le
constructs.description: Le replacing an adjective, an infinitive or a whole clause.

constructs.name: article défini
constructs.description: Definite articles, used for specific or known things and for general statements.

constructs.name: article indéfini
constructs.description: Indefinite articles, introducing countable things not yet identified.

constructs.name: article contracté
constructs.description: Contraction of à and de with the definite articles le and les.

constructs.name: article partitif
constructs.description: Partitive article for an unspecified amount of something uncountable.

constructs.name: article après une négation
constructs.description: Indefinite and partitive articles becoming de after a negation.

constructs.name: absence d'article
constructs.description: Cases where no article is used, such as after some prepositions, in lists or before professions.

constructs.name: expressions de quantité + de
constructs.description: Adverbs and nouns of quantity followed by de and a noun without article.

constructs.name: adjectifs possessifs
constructs.description: Possessive determiners agreeing with the thing possessed, not the possessor.

constructs.name: adjectifs démonstratifs
constructs.description: Demonstrative determiners pointing to a thing or a time.

constructs.name: adjectif indéfini tout
constructs.description: Tout as a determiner meaning all or every, agreeing with the noun.

constructs.name: déterminants indéfinis
constructs.description: Determiners expressing an imprecise quantity or each element of a set.

constructs.name: indéfinis avec n'importe
constructs.description: N'importe plus a determiner, pronoun or adverb, meaning any at all.

constructs.name: genre des noms
constructs.description: Grammatical gender of nouns and the feminine of nouns for people.

constructs.name: pluriel des noms
constructs.description: Plural of nouns in -s and in -x, and spoken vs written plural marks.

constructs.name: féminin des adjectifs
constructs.description: Feminine forms of adjectives, regular and irregular.

constructs.name: pluriel des adjectifs
constructs.description: Plural forms of adjectives and their agreement with the noun.

constructs.name: accord du participe passé avec être
constructs.description: Past participle agreeing with the subject in compound tenses with être.

constructs.name: accord du participe passé avec avoir
constructs.description: Past participle agreeing with a direct object placed before the verb in tenses with avoir.

constructs.name: accord du participe passé des verbes pronominaux
aliases: past participle agreement of reflexive verbs
constructs.description: Agreement of the past participle of pronominal verbs, depending on the role of the reflexive pronoun.

constructs.name: accords particuliers du participe passé
constructs.description: Special cases of past participle agreement, such as with en, before an infinitive or with verbs of measure.

constructs.name: prépositions de lieu
constructs.description: Prepositions and prepositional phrases locating something in space.

constructs.name: prépositions devant les noms géographiques
constructs.description: Choice of preposition before names of cities, countries and regions.

constructs.name: prépositions de temps
constructs.description: Prepositions situating an event in time: hours, dates, months, years.

constructs.name: expression de la durée
aliases: depuis, il y a, pendant, dans
constructs.description: Prepositions and expressions for duration and the time elapsed since or until an event.

constructs.name: verbe + préposition + nom
constructs.description: Verbs whose complement is introduced by a preposition, mainly à or de.

constructs.name: adjectif + préposition + nom
constructs.description: Adjectives followed by a preposition and a noun.

constructs.name: complément du nom
constructs.description: A noun followed by de or à and another noun to specify it.

constructs.name: négation ne ... pas
constructs.description: Basic negation around the conjugated verb.

constructs.name: négation sans verbe
constructs.description: Pas or non used alone or before a word, without a verb.

constructs.name: ne ... jamais
constructs.description: Negation meaning never.

constructs.name: ne ... plus
constructs.description: Negation meaning no longer.

constructs.name: pronoms négatifs (rien, personne)
constructs.description: Negative pronouns meaning nothing and nobody, as object or as subject.

constructs.name: négation de l'infinitif
constructs.description: Both parts of the negation placed together before an infinitive.

constructs.name: ne ... que (restriction)
constructs.description: Restriction meaning only, which is not a true negation.

constructs.name: ne ... aucun
constructs.description: Negative determiner or pronoun meaning not a single one.

constructs.name: ne ... ni ... ni
constructs.description: Negation of two or more coordinated elements.

constructs.name: ne ... nulle part
constructs.description: Negation meaning nowhere.

constructs.name: combinaison de négations
constructs.description: Combining several negative words in one clause, and the negative restriction ne pas ... que.

constructs.name: ne explétif
constructs.description: A ne without negative meaning in formal style after expressions of fear, some conjunctions and comparisons.

constructs.name: négations littéraires (ne ... guère, ne ... point)
constructs.description: Literary negations meaning hardly or not at all.

constructs.name: interrogation par intonation
constructs.description: Yes/no question formed with rising intonation and statement word order.

constructs.name: interrogation avec est-ce que
constructs.description: Questions formed with est-ce que, alone or after a question word.

constructs.name: mots interrogatifs
aliases: qui, où, quand, comment, pourquoi, combien
constructs.description: Question words for person, place, time, manner, reason and quantity, placed first or last.

constructs.name: déterminant interrogatif quel
constructs.description: Quel agreeing with the noun to ask which or what.

constructs.name: qui est-ce et qu'est-ce que c'est
aliases: who is it, what is it
constructs.description: Fixed questions to identify a person or a thing.

constructs.name: interrogation par inversion
constructs.description: Question formed by inverting subject pronoun and verb, typical of formal style.

constructs.name: interrogation par inversion complexe
constructs.description: Question with a noun subject kept first and taken up by a subject pronoun inverted after the verb.

constructs.name: interrogation avec préposition
constructs.description: Questions where a preposition comes before the question word.

constructs.name: pronoms interrogatifs avec est-ce
constructs.description: Interrogative pronouns reinforced with est-ce qui or est-ce que, distinguishing subject and object.

constructs.name: réponse si à une question négative
constructs.description: Si used instead of oui to contradict a negative question or statement.

constructs.name: pronom interrogatif lequel
constructs.description: Lequel and its forms asking which one among several.

constructs.name: conjonctions de coordination
constructs.description: Joining words, phrases or clauses with coordinating conjunctions.

constructs.name: cause (conjonction + indicatif)
constructs.description: Expressing cause with conjunctions followed by the indicative.

constructs.name: conséquence (connecteurs)
constructs.description: Expressing consequence with adverbs and connectors.

constructs.name: but (préposition + nom ou infinitif)
constructs.description: Expressing purpose with a preposition followed by a noun or an infinitive.

constructs.name: cause (préposition + nom)
constructs.description: Expressing cause with a preposition followed by a noun.

constructs.name: proposition complétive à l'indicatif
constructs.description: A que-clause in the indicative as the object of a verb of saying, thinking or knowing.

constructs.name: hypothèse sur le futur (si + présent)
constructs.description: A si-clause in the present with a main clause in the present, future or imperative.

constructs.name: connecteurs chronologiques
constructs.description: Connectors ordering the steps of a story or a list.

constructs.name: connecteurs d'addition
aliases: en plus, de plus, en outre
constructs.description: Connectors adding an element or an argument.

constructs.name: connecteurs de reformulation
constructs.description: Connectors introducing a rewording or explanation of what was said.

constructs.name: hypothèse sur le présent (si + imparfait)
constructs.description: A si-clause in the imperfect with a main clause in the present conditional, for unlikely or imagined situations.

constructs.name: si + imparfait (suggestion)
constructs.description: An independent si-clause in the imperfect used to make a suggestion.

constructs.name: proposition subordonnée de temps (indicatif)
constructs.description: Time clauses in the indicative for simultaneity or succession.

constructs.name: discours indirect au présent
constructs.description: Reporting statements, questions and orders with a reporting verb in the present.

constructs.name: interrogation indirecte
aliases: si, ce que, ce qui + discours indirect
constructs.description: Questions embedded after a verb, with statement word order.

constructs.name: opposition (conjonction + indicatif)
constructs.description: Contrasting two facts with conjunctions followed by the indicative.

constructs.name: concession (connecteurs)
constructs.description: Expressing concession with adverbs and connectors.

constructs.name: concession (préposition + nom)
constructs.description: Expressing concession with a preposition followed by a noun.

constructs.name: concession avec même si
constructs.description: Même si followed by the indicative to express concession.

constructs.name: connecteurs de conclusion
constructs.description: Connectors closing an argument or a story.

constructs.name: opposition (connecteurs)
aliases: en revanche, par contre, au contraire
constructs.description: Contrasting two facts with adverbs and connectors.

constructs.name: hypothèse sur le passé (si + plus-que-parfait)
constructs.description: A si-clause in the pluperfect with a past or present conditional for unreal past situations.

constructs.name: hypothèse sans si
constructs.description: Expressing a condition or hypothesis with prepositions, au cas où, a gerund or other means than si.

constructs.name: discours indirect au passé (concordance des temps)
constructs.description: Shifting tenses and time expressions when the reporting verb is in the past.

constructs.name: conséquence (conjonction + indicatif)
aliases: si bien que, de sorte que
constructs.description: Expressing consequence with conjunctions followed by the indicative.

constructs.name: conséquence liée à l'intensité
aliases: si ... que, tant ... que, tellement ... que
constructs.description: Consequence linked to an intensity or quantity: an adverb in the main clause and que.

constructs.name: proposition participiale
constructs.description: A participle clause with its own subject, expressing cause or time in formal writing.

constructs.name: après que + indicatif
constructs.description: Après que followed by the indicative for an action completed before the main one.

constructs.name: cause (conjonctions de justification)
constructs.description: Conjunctions that add or stress a justifying cause.

constructs.name: comparatif de l'adjectif et de l'adverbe
aliases: plus ... que, moins ... que, aussi ... que
constructs.description: Comparing qualities with plus, moins or aussi before an adjective or adverb and que.

constructs.name: comparatif du nom et du verbe
aliases: plus de ... que, autant de ... que
constructs.description: Comparing quantities and actions with plus (de), moins (de), autant (de) and que.

constructs.name: comparatifs et superlatifs irréguliers
constructs.description: Irregular comparative and superlative forms of good and well.

constructs.name: superlatif
constructs.description: Article plus plus or moins to express the highest or lowest degree.

constructs.name: comparaison progressive
aliases: de plus en plus, de moins en moins
constructs.description: Expressing a gradual increase or decrease.

constructs.name: comparaison de ressemblance
constructs.description: Expressing sameness or similarity with comme, le même ... que and similar words.

constructs.name: comparaison proportionnelle
constructs.description: Two parallel clauses expressing proportion.

constructs.name: place de l'adjectif
aliases: adjectif avant ou après le nom
constructs.description: Most adjectives follow the noun; a small group of short frequent adjectives comes before it.

constructs.name: place des pronoms compléments
constructs.description: Object pronouns placed before the conjugated verb, or before the infinitive they depend on.

constructs.name: place des pronoms à l'impératif
constructs.description: Object pronouns after the verb with a hyphen in the affirmative imperative, before it in the negative.

constructs.name: dislocation
constructs.description: Placing an element at the start or end of the sentence and taking it up with a pronoun, for emphasis.

constructs.name: mise en relief (c'est ... qui, c'est ... que)
constructs.description: Highlighting one element of the sentence by framing it with c'est and a relative pronoun.

constructs.name: mise en relief (ce qui ..., c'est)
constructs.description: Highlighting with a ce qui/ce que/ce dont clause taken up by c'est.

constructs.name: place de l'adverbe
constructs.description: Position of adverbs after the conjugated verb, and between auxiliary and participle in compound tenses.

constructs.name: adjectifs à sens variable selon la place
aliases: un grand homme, un homme grand
constructs.description: Adjectives whose meaning changes depending on whether they come before or after the noun.

constructs.name: inversion du sujet après certains adverbes
constructs.description: Subject-verb inversion in formal writing after some adverbs placed first in the clause.

constructs.name: présentatifs (c'est, voici, voilà)
constructs.description: Expressions used to present or identify a person or thing.

constructs.name: il y a
constructs.description: Impersonal il y a stating that something exists or is present.

constructs.name: adverbes d'intensité et de quantité
constructs.description: Adverbs modifying the degree of an adjective, adverb or verb.

constructs.name: phrase exclamative
constructs.description: Exclamatory sentences with an exclamative word or intonation.

constructs.name: phrase nominale
constructs.description: Sentences without a conjugated verb, typical of signs, titles and headlines.

constructs.name: adverbes en -ment
constructs.description: Forming adverbs of manner from the feminine of the adjective plus -ment, with the -amment/-emment forms.

constructs.name: nominalisation
constructs.description: Turning a verb or adjective into a noun, often to make writing more compact.

constructs.name: apposition
constructs.description: A noun phrase placed beside a noun, usually between commas, to identify or describe it, often without an article.
